About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Engineering Manager II, Runtime Services

Millions of people across the world come to Pinterest to find new ideas every day. It’s where they get inspiration, dream about new possibilities and plan for what matters most. Our mission is to help those people find their inspiration and create a life they love. As a Pinterest employee, you’ll be challenged to take on work that upholds this mission and pushes Pinterest forward.

What you’ll do: 

  • Establish the strategy, charter and operating model for a new team responsible for two major platforms.
    • Pinterest’s large-scale asynchronous job scheduling and execution platform, and 
    • its anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, and ML monitoring platform.
  • Lead the technical roadmap & evolution of these platforms, advancing automation, self-service onboarding, resource efficiency and reliability.
  • Build strong partnerships with teams across Pinterest to understand customer needs, drive adoption and deliver measurable improvements in developer productivity and data-driven decision-making.
  • Strengthen operational excellence across both platforms by improving observability, incident response, service health, documentation and engineering practices.
  • Hire, coach and grow a high-performing team while establishing an inclusive culture of ownership, learning and continuous improvement.
  • Use AI to accelerate planning, technical exploration, documentation and operational analysis, applying sound judgment and verification to ensure the quality and correctness of final outcomes. E.g. AI can be used for user onboarding, routine agentic evaluation of ongoing tasks.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 9 years of software engineering experience, including deep expertise in distributed platforms and solid familiarity with backend systems & interest in algorithms in anomaly detection domain.
  • Minimum 2 years of engineering management experience leading strong platform & backend highly available engineering teams.
  • Strong technical foundation in platform reliability, observability, Kubernetes or cloud infrastructure, data systems and developer experience.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous execution, workflow orchestration and passion for machine learning algorithms. 
  • Experience setting technical strategy and delivering meaningful improvements to platform scalability, operational efficiency, customer adoption or engineering velocity.
  • Ability to lead work across platforms and collaborate effectively with cross-functional partners.
  • Clear communication skills, strong technical judgment, and a people-focused leadership approach.
  • Experience using AI to accelerate engineering planning, analysis and execution, with a clear approach to validating accuracy, quality and security.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Relocation Statement: 

  • This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.

In-Office Requirement Statement: 

  • We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
  • This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter, and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.

 

#LI-HYBRID

At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.

Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.

US based applicants only
$208,592—$429,454 USD
